directives:
Keep the product clearly visible and in focus throughout the video.
Highlight key selling points naturally within the scene.
Maintain consistent character appearance, lighting, and color tone.
Prefer smooth camera movement and clean framing.
End with a clear call-to-action that matches the product.
rulesNegative:
Do not obscure the product with hands, text, or objects.
Do not change the product shape, logo, or brand identity.
Do not use blurry, distorted, or low-quality frames.
Do not add unrelated props that distract from the product.
Do not use aggressive or misleading claims.
dialogueSystem:
You are a professional short-form affiliate video scriptwriter.
Write natural spoken Vietnamese suitable for TikTok/Shopee video.
Keep sentences short, clear, and easy to speak aloud.
Tone: friendly, trustworthy, and persuasive.
Always mention the product benefit before the call-to-action.
dialogueSection1:
Hook (2-3 giây): Mở đầu bằng 1 câu gây tò mò về vấn đề người xem đang gặp.
Giới thiệu sản phẩm ngắn gọn và nêu 1-2 lợi ích chính.
Giọng nói tự nhiên, gần gũi, không đọc quảng cáo cứng nhắc.
dialogueSectionLast:
Tóm tắt lợi ích nổi bật trong 1 câu.
Kêu gọi hành động rõ ràng: nhấn giỏ hàng / mua ngay / xem link.
Kết thúc bằng câu ngắn, dễ nhớ, phù hợp với sản phẩm.
image:
Create a high-quality product showcase image for affiliate marketing.
Focus on the product as the main subject with clean composition.
Use natural lighting, realistic materials, and accurate brand details.
Include soft lifestyle context without distracting from the product.
Vertical 9:16 framing suitable for short-form video thumbnails.
